note: Found by O1's DecisionRingLeaf tests: sb-posix:fsync under XDTRACE is red, but the same I/O through a host function the checker does not resolve as an I/O leaf (fnn-write-all) is not. Affects every leaf row (XTRACE, XDTRACE, XPWAKE, XTLSKX, ...) and every io_ok=false lock. Fix at the root: the checker's call graph must follow host defuns transitively to their io leaves (or refuse an unresolved callee under a no-I/O lock), with a teeth test: fnn-write-all under a leaf is red.
title: lock_discipline does not see I/O reached under a lock through an unrecognised host wrapper (e.g. fnn-write-all), so any leaf lock can do I/O undetected
